prompt:
One uninterrupted 5-second cinematic shot. Use the supplied video (Video 1) as the authoritative 3D camera, blocking, geometry, occlusion and timing reference. Image 1 is the finished appearance of the opening view; Image 2 is the finished appearance of the ending view of this SAME set. Apply their tactile stylized-3D fantasy film look throughout the moving shot. The video controls motion; the images control the character, materials, lighting and visual finish.

Reproduce the reference camera path and its changing viewpoint through space, not a zoom or a pan across an image. Begin at low waist height, rear three-quarter view of a tired young adult desert laborer, a nearby stone column obscuring the left edge. During the first 2.2 seconds he takes the same two heavy steps as in the video, holding one small bronze oil lamp low in his LEFT hand. Match his foot contacts, body weight and travel distance. He settles to a stop, with only the slight head/shoulder turn from the reference. The camera follows the same smooth approximately 100-degree arc and gently rises from about 1.1 to 1.8 metres, using a fixed 35mm perspective. Keep the exact direction and ease-in/ease-out of the source. The foreground column exits quickly, background pillars slide more slowly; their visible sides and overlaps genuinely change. The man transitions from rear three-quarter toward side/front three-quarter view. A tall blue floating crystal on its round three-step altar is revealed on screen RIGHT during the latter half. By 4.5 seconds the man occupies the lower LEFT, cropped around the waist, and the crystal is fully readable on the RIGHT, matching the reference ending view. Settle and hold the final composition for the last 0.5 second with subtle breathing. Do not make the man spin to imitate the camera.

Maintain one coherent three-dimensional terrace: existing columns, parapet, slabs, crystal, two small crystal satellites and altar retain their positions and relative sizes. Preserve the man and lamp continuously through occlusions. Same tan face, tousled dark hair, light stubble, dusty cream patched short-sleeve tunic, rust-red scarf, brown leather back straps and pouch, loose brown trousers, wrist wraps and boots as the images. Fine cloth and worn sandstone texture, tarnished bronze, restrained translucent cyan crystal with internal refraction, deep indigo desert night, cool moonlit edges and subtle warm bounce. Organic cloth and hair secondary motion; grounded, exhausted acting. Finished feature-animation render quality with natural depth of field.

No cuts, transitions, dissolves, static-image warping, flat sliding layers, digital push-in, added actions, added people, new architecture, changing costume, duplicate lamp, text or UI. No corruption, lightning, magic streams or crystal fracture yet. Silent shot.
